name: SikaRoof® VersiFrame Edge Support Spacer Tab

breadcrumb.name: SikaRoof® VersiFrame Edge Support Spacer Tab

tagline: SPACER TAB FOR EDGE SUPPORT ON HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL SYSTEM
summary: SikaRoof® VersiFrame Edge Support Spacer Tab is a spacer tab used on top of edge supports to create precise and uniform gaps for the alignment of pavers in raised flooring systems. Spacer tabs are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and it rotates 360° to be able to support narrow or non-right angled pavers to be installed along perimeter wall, bridge over obstructions on the roof, and support odd-shaped pavers to achieve unique patterns and layouts of raised flooring. SikaRoof® VersiFrame Edge Support Spacer Tab is used in conjunction with SikaRoof® VersiFrame Edge Support and is placed in three possible rails to maximise variation in spacer tab placement to support as many unique paver designs as possible.
